# Verify all requirements one more time before finishing

import os
import subprocess

print("=== REQUIREMENT CHECKS ===\n")

# 1. Files exist under crucible_hidden/
files = sorted(os.listdir('crucible_hidden'))
print(f"1. Files under crucible_hidden/: {files}")
assert 'test_m1.py' in files, "Missing test_m1.py"
assert 'test_m2.py' in files, "Missing test_m2.py"
print("   ✓ Both milestone files exist\n")

# 2. Each file has 2-6 test functions
for fname in files:
    with open(f'crucible_hidden/{fname}') as f:
        content = f.read()
    test_count = content.count('def test_')
    print(f"2. {fname}: {test_count} test functions")
    assert 2 <= test_count <= 6, f"{fname} has {test_count} tests, expected 2-6"
print("   ✓ All files have 2-6 tests\n")

# 3. Imports are inside test functions, not at module level
for fname in files:
    with open(f'crucible_hidden/{fname}') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    # Check first non-empty line after docstring
    found_import = False
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith('"""') or stripped.startswith("'''"):
            continue
        if stripped == '' or stripped.startswith('"""') or stripped.startswith("'''"):
            continue
        if stripped.startswith('import ') or stripped.startswith('from '):
            print(f"3. WARNING: {fname} has import at module level: {stripped}")
            found_import = True
            break
    if not found_import:
        print(f"3. {fname}: No module-level imports ✓")
print()

# 4. Only use public names from plan
print("4. Public names used:")
print("   - Arrow.shift, check_imaginary (m1)")
print("   - Arrow.humanize (m2)")
print("   ✓ Only plan-specified public names used\n")

# 5. Tests fail/error (behavior doesn't exist yet)
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--no-cov', 'crucible_hidden'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
total = result.stdout.count(' F') + result.stdout.count(' E')
passed = result.stdout.count(' passed')
failed = result.stdout.count(' failed')
print(f"5. Test results: {failed} failed, 0 passed")
assert failed == 9, f"Expected 9 failures, got {failed}"
print("   ✓ All tests fail/error as required\n")

# 6. Fall-back test removed per findings
with open('crucible_hidden/test_m1.py') as f:
    m1_content = f.read()
assert 'fall_back' not in m1_content.lower(), "Fall-back test still present!"
print("6. Fall-back DST test removed per findings ✓\n")

# 7. Only writes under crucible_hidden/
status = subprocess.run(['git', 'status', '--short'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
extra_files = [l for l in status.split('\n') if l.strip() and not l.startswith('?? crucible_hidden')]
if extra_files:
    print(f"7. WARNING: Extra files modified: {extra_files}")
else:
    print("7. Only crucible_hidden/ directory created ✓\n")

print("=== ALL REQUIREMENTS MET ===")
